case_state.description: Whether office handling is still active.

referral_state.description: Progress of an expert referral handoff.

completion_refusals.description: Distinct reasons the office refuses a field-validation completion upload. Codes are stable; clients may branch on them.

ASSIGNMENT_REASSIGNED.meaning: The visit now belongs to another inspector.

CASE_CLOSED.meaning: The case is no longer open, so it cannot receive field-validation evidence.

COMPLETED_ELSEWHERE.meaning: The case is already marked field-validation completed or the assignment has a completion with a different client_uuid. When a completion record exists, completed_at contains its creation time in ISO 8601 UTC.

VISIT_REMOVED.meaning: The office removed the visit; the assignment no longer exists.

CONFLICT.meaning: A different completion action conflicts with the current state.

assigned_to_other_inspector.effect: assignee changes on the same assignment

removed_by_office.effect: assignment deleted while no completion exists

same_major_compatible_widening: adding optional metadata without changing lifecycle meanings
adding enum values while preserving existing state meanings
adding completion refusal codes and assignment transitions without changing existing code meanings
new_major_required: removing or renaming a dimension or state
changing state ownership, transition meaning, or legacy projection
making field-validation completion imply verification or closure
treating AI evidence as authority verification
